name: wave
description: Run waves of unsupervised workers on agent-ready Linear, Jira or ClickUp issues, on Orca or on a direct git-worktree runtime: per-repo config, worker prompt contract, pre-PR Codex/Grok review, labelling triage, the fresh-session checklist (leftovers, brain save, sweep), and an autonomy tick that drives spawn, CI, challenge and merge without a session in the loop. Consumes the brain plugin (/brain:resume, /brain:save); brain never depends on it.
